Hello Michael,

I am writing on behalf of Jon Clark regarding your 2016 Nissan Altima.

We have reviewed the market data for a vehicle with 83,223 miles, and the asking price of $12,600 sits slightly above the KBB range top ($12,540). Given the age of the vehicle, we believe a more realistic valuation is closer to the average private party value.

Before we can move forward, we need a clear picture of the mechanical history. Nissans from this era have a reputation for specific transmission issues. Do you have full maintenance records? Has the CVT fluid been serviced regularly, and have there been any recent significant repairs or known issues?

We want to buy a healthy car, but we price based on facts. Assuming the mechanicals are solid and the records are complete, Jon is prepared to start the conversation with an offer of **$9,500**. If there are any mechanical red flags, the offer will be adjusted downward to cover necessary repairs.

Please let us know regarding the service history.

Best regards,

Jon Clark's Agent
